question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: live.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the use of the given words.
 
• **Live** (verb) means to have a home or residence in a particular place.
 
 
• **Living**: (Verb + ing) It is used only in the continuous tense.
 
• **Lives**: It is used when the subject is written in the third person form or simply singular subjects.
 
• **Live**: It is used for plural subjects.
 
• **Lived**: The 3rd form of "live", and it is only used when the sentence is written in the past tense.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence the subject "**people**" is also a plural subject which means all the men, women and children who belong to a particular place or race.
 
• Therefore, "**live**" should be used in this sentence just like it is also written as "*Stray dogs reside __on the...*"
 
• So, as per the use of the given words "live" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Complete passage: Stray dogs reside on the streets or in neighbourhoods and slums, where they feed on unsanitary waste made by the people who ***__(1) live__*** there. They frequently do not have enough food to eat, and as a result, the majority of them (2)____________ malnourished. Local area (3)____________ is also a source of worry, as just a few individuals treat them with kindness, while the majority regard them as a (4)___________. In addition, they are subjected to harsh practices such as (5)_______________ and beating.
